topic: How many hearts does an octopus have?

slides.title: Two pump blood through the gills, one pumps it to the rest of the body.

caption:
Octopuses have three hearts. Two pump blood through the gills and one serves the body, and that one pauses during swimming. How many hearts do you have? Tell us in one word. 🐙
